title: [Prime, DashPass] Free 10 Wicked Wings with $20 Order + Service Fee @ KFC via DoorDash
body:

[Poison Ivy] Are any of the meals on Doordash worth getting to make it worth over the cheaper and usually better promo family deals on the KFC app?
I guess you could price the additional item as $10 to offset it.

[nosytt] I was already this fat an lazy thoughbeit
[s0805] On slightly different topic, i tried numerous time to link my prime with doordash account with any luck. Just gave up in the end.
[bigbadboogieman] How is this a deal?
Pickup Order using KFC app :
Burger feast = $39.95
10 Wicked Wings = $14.95
Total = $54.90
Dashpass :
Burger feast = $49.65
10 Wicked Wings = $0
Service fee = $5.96
Total = $55.61
[eecan] Whether the meals are worth it is one thing but I assume you are comparing pick up price with delivery?
I'd happily pay $0.70 for someone to deliver food on demand within 30-60min and there is no way in hell I'd be going out and picking up anyone's order if they only paid me a dollar to do so.
[bigbadboogieman] Yeah I am assessing the deal based on food price. It's not a deal if the food itself is more expensive than what it's normally sold for. Delivery is not free, you've paid for Dashpass separately. Also if you've got it as part of a promotion for e.g. Amazon prime, even then it's not free, it's "included" in the price you pay for Prime.

[elektron] The Red Rooster $10 whole roast chicken deal is a better deal in my opinion and is definitely healthier.
